# Commit map: old hash (private archive) -> new hash (this repository)

This repository's history is the private development history with personal details replaced (names, addresses, machine paths) and the
author identity set to the public handle, so every commit hash changed. Documents written before the first public release cite OLD hashes
(builds, "pair" records, evidence); look them up here. Pull request and issue numbers cited in those documents refer to the private archive.

353 commits. Format: `old-hash new-hash` (full 40-character hashes).
